caption: The drawing depicts an aerial view of a garden with a geometric, grid-like layout. The garden is divided into several rectangular and polygonal plots, each filled with different patterns arranged in lines, circles, and other geometric shapes. The plots contain representations of various plants or crops in colors such as green, yellow, red, pink, orange, and brown. The central-southern area of the garden features multiple smaller, square plots with densely-packed rows in vibrant colors. The top half of the garden contains more elongated, rectangular plots with plantings arranged in diagonal and straight lines, some featuring circular patterns. Surrounding the garden are green lawns and a number of stylized trees scattered throughout the landscape. A wide path or road leads into the garden from the left side, branching off in multiple directions. Buildings or structures in grey and white are present near the garden entrance and at the lower left corner. The drawing uses mostly green tones for the landscape, with the garden plots standing out due to their more intense and varied color palette. The borders of the plots and paths are highlighted in light beige or tan. The entire composition is surrounded by a beige border.
title: Nicholas Bayard Estate
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
